svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Laser cut two spiders from 6 mm steel: three arms 45 mm wide at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 degrees, round ends of 22.5 mm radius, a 96 mm centre disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: 76 mm in the centre for the hub; 20 mm for each stub axle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 mm from the centre (260 mm apart, hole to hole).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: a 1610 weld-on taper-lock hub, 76 mm across and 26 mm long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the centre hole, 10 mm proud each side; weld both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stub axles (make 6): 20 mm bright bar cut to 55 mm; drill 8.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and tap M10 20 deep in one end. Push through each 20 mm hole,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plain end flush with the spider's inner face; weld both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make the two spiders as a mirrored pair: stubs on the outer side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stubs are square to the spider within 0.5 mm over

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm, and all three at 150 mm, within 0.5 mm, from the centre.
